title: $(2,2k)$-hypercontractivity in norm form
statement:
Fix an integer $k \ge 1$ and a real noise rate $\rho$ satisfying $\rho^2 \le
\tfrac{1}{2k-1}$. Then for every Boolean function $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the image
$T_\rho f$ under the noise operator obeys the $L^2$-to-$L^{2k}$ hypercontractive bound
\[
  \bigl(\E\bigl[(T_\rho f)^{2k}\bigr]\bigr)^{1/(2k)} \;\le\; \bigl(\E[f^2]\bigr)^{1/2},
\]
where the expectation is taken with respect to the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: k is an integer with k ≥ 1
f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $k \ge 1$ and noise parameter $\rho$ with $\rho^2 \le 1/(2k-1)$, the $(2,2k)$
bound in the form $\norm{T_\rho f}_{2k} \le \norm{f}_2$:
\[
  \bigl(\E[(T_\rho f)^{2k}]\bigr)^{1/(2k)} \le \bigl(\E[f^2]\bigr)^{1/2}.
\]
